name: How long does a fixer-upper renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a fixer-upper renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a fixer-upper renovation depends on its complexity. Smaller projects, such as painting, flooring, and minor updates, might take 1-3 months. More extensive renovations involving kitchen, bathroom, or multiple room remodels usually require 3-6 months. Major structural changes, additions, or whole-home overhauls can extend to 6-12 months or more. We establish a clear project timeline upfront, including phases for design, permitting, demolition, construction, and finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation timelines vary: 1-3 months for minor updates, 3-6 months for extensive remodels, and 6-12+ months for major overhauls.
